name: @cloudroom/desktop
description: macOS, Linux, and Windows Electron shell for bapX Agents

scripts.desktop:build: pnpm run build --stamp && node scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs --stamp --mac --arm64 --publish never
scripts.desktop:build:linux: pnpm run build --stamp && node scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs --stamp --linux --x64 --publish never
scripts.desktop:build:win: pnpm run build --stamp && node scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs --win --x64 --publish never --stamp
scripts.dev: pnpm run prepare-runtime && pnpm run build && node --conditions=source --import tsx scripts/run-electron-dev.mjs
scripts.dist: pnpm run prepare-runtime && pnpm run desktop:build
scripts.dist:linux: pnpm run prepare-runtime && pnpm run desktop:build:linux
scripts.dist:win: pnpm run prepare-runtime && pnpm run desktop:build:win
scripts.package: pnpm run prepare-runtime && pnpm run build --stamp && node scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs --stamp --mac --dir --arm64
scripts.package:linux: pnpm run prepare-runtime && pnpm run build --stamp && node scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs --stamp --linux --dir --x64
scripts.package:win: pnpm run prepare-runtime && pnpm run build --stamp && node scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs --win --dir --x64 --stamp
